sections.title: Follow-up appointment
sections.text: Arrange a follow-up visit with Dr. Maya Chen within seven days of discharge. Call the clinic if you need help arranging the visit.

sections.title: Paperwork
sections.text: Bring your discharge summary and current medication list to the follow-up visit.

sections.title: Recovery check-in
sections.text: Complete the recovery check-in on September 21, 2026. Record any questions you want to discuss with your care team.

sections.title: Instructions to clarify
sections.text: The discharge note mentions a repeat laboratory test, but does not specify the test or a date. Contact the discharge team for clarification before arranging it.

lines.text: > homeward-discharge-copilot@1.0.0 eval
> node scripts/evaluate.js
PASS Discharge summaries are source-linked, patient-scoped reads with explicit missing dates
PASS Summaries keep unreviewed and Synthea passages separate from actionable instructions
PASS Summary snapshots follow review/help changes without rewriting original instructions
PASS Agent references cannot inject clinical prose, cross patients, or invent action receipts
PASS Next-step chat and plan agree for every seeded patient without clinical mutations
PASS Guidance distinguishes undated, paused, clarification, completed, and rejected tasks
PASS Guidance uses reviewed instructions and labels human dates without rewriting exact quotes
PASS Guidance fails closed on invalid citations, historical instructions, and invalid dates
PASS Next-step recognition is bounded and specific source search preserves punctuation
PASS Guidance has stable date ordering and does not bypass reminder approval or help gates
PASS Review activates an exact instruction with an evidenced date and separate reminder approval
PASS Review with no deadline leaves due null and prevents reminders
PASS Clarify and reject preserve sources and cannot be bypassed by completion or a duplicate proposal
PASS Synthea history requires a separate exact instruction; a review note cannot authorize it
PASS Invalid calendar dates and unsupported date evidence never mutate the task
PASS Review commands reject foreign tasks, foreign evidence, fabricated quotes, and reviewer impersonation
PASS Review retries replay one receipt; stale revisions and reused keys cannot overwrite newer decisions
PASS A new reviewed instruction invalidates old reminders even when status and date are unchanged
PASS Responding to and resolving help never approves an unverified task
PASS Help persists after reopening SQLite and remains patient scoped
PASS Every fixture task has an exact source
PASS Unknown deadlines stay unknown
PASS Execution without approval is blocked
PASS Patient boundaries reject foreign records
PASS Retry after response loss creates no duplicate
PASS Declined actions cannot execute
PASS Fabricated citations are rejected
PASS Imported instructions require human review
PASS Missing answers are not invented
PASS Changed tasks invalidate pending execution
PASS Repeated proposals reuse the existing action
PASS Agent runs have bounded tool access and iterations

captions.text: Discharge instructions arrive when patients are
exhausted, and one unclear line can stall recovery.
Homeward turns the saved record
into a plan Alex can follow.
View source opens the exact
sentence behind each step.
Alex asks what paperwork to bring,
and source search answers with the cited passage.
The lab instruction names no test or date,
so Alex asks for help.
The care team replies, and the task stays
open until the details are confirmed.
A reminder waits for Alex's approval.
When the response is lost, Retry safely returns
the original receipt, so no second reminder appears.
The agent activity log records every step.
Four role-scoped specialists select references,
and the server validates patient,
record version, and approval.
All 32 guardrail checks pass, alongside
59 backend tests and four interface journeys.
Uncertainty stays visible,
and every instruction keeps its source.
